summary: This note describes Koparit, a football club from Kuopio, Finland, originally named Kuopion Pallotoverit (KPT). The club was founded in 1931 and disbanded in 1990. It spent 21 seasons in the Finnish premier division Mestaruussarja between 1938 and 1987, finished runner-up twice, and played two UEFA Cup campaigns, losing in the first round both times.
one_line: Koparit was a Kuopio, Finland football club active from 1931 to 1990, known for two Mestaruussarja runner-up finishes.
key_facts: Koparit was originally named Kuopion Pallotoverit, or KPT for short.
Koparit was a football club from Kuopio, Finland.
Koparit played a total of 21 seasons in the Finnish premier division Mestaruussarja.
Koparit's Mestaruussarja seasons spanned from 1938 to 1987.
Koparit reached the runners-up position in Mestaruussarja twice, in the 1978 and 1981 seasons.
Koparit participated in the UEFA Cup in the 1979–80 and 1982–83 seasons.
Koparit was knocked out of the UEFA Cup in the first round in both of its UEFA Cup attempts.
